name: BRAND TEXT
description:
Founded over 10 years ago as a pool chemical company, Blue Wave started with one simple goal: provide consumers with the products they demand at a level of quality that exceeds their expectations. With product lines ranging from full above-ground pool kits and a wide range of pool accessories/equipment to unique brands of in-home table games and saunas, we have continued to expand our offerings to ensure that dealers and consumers are able to find the products they need.



On top of the wide range of brands that Blue Wave both manufactures and distributes, we also pride ourselves on our top-notch shipping abilities as well as the superb customer service we offer. We are aware that the highest quality products mean nothing if there is no service to back them up or they do not arrive in a timely manner. For this reason, we have built a centrally located warehouse in the Chicagoland area to house all of our products, helping keep shipping costs, and times, down. We also have a full staff of knowledgeable product specialists waiting to answer any question you may have, so you can be confident that you are making an educated buying choice.
